verdict.rationale: Dual-booting is a fair question for an operating system, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents installing macOS alongside a switcher's existing OS. The only nearby item, "Run Windows on your Mac", goes the opposite direction and does not say it is a dual-boot setup, so it is an adjacent feature that earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can install the OS alongside my existing OS in a dual-boot configuration
